source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, before you begin developing concepts, we’ll send over some concepts that appeal to us, though naturally we also want to see your own ideas. Please hold off on starting the concepts until we’ve got back to you. Thanks, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Understood. I’ll develop a few concepts that closely reflect your vision, while introducing a creative element so the designs remain unique and visually appealing.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], please review the initial drafts and share your thoughts with me. I’d be very interested to receive your feedback.

If you want any revisions, refinements, iterations, or changes, please feel free to say so. I’m happy to continue working with you until the result aligns perfectly with your vision.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer presents the initial logo drafts for client review.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you for these. We like the graduated orange colour and the lines beside the strapline.

Our preferences are the 1st and 3rd one, since the font used in the 2nd one feels too plain. However, someone unfamiliar with our name might not understand that the flame in the 3rd one represents an ‘O’, even though we like it.

Perhaps the flame could sit inside an ‘O’, be reshaped to look more like an ‘O’, or be superimposed over an ‘O’. Could you test all of those suggestions?

For logo 3, could we also see how it looks with ‘dough’ made slightly larger? To make the strapline more prominent, could you either outline every letter with a thin black pencil line or slightly brighten the orange tones used in the strapline lettering? We like the global dough font because it has character, particularly the G. We wondered whether a little ‘character’ could be added to a couple of the other letters, but thought it would be better to handle the revisions one stage at a time, as the existing font may be okay. Thank you—we’re moving in the right direction.

execution.observed_behavior: Client evaluates three delivered initial concepts, identifies preferred options, and confirms that the design process is moving in the right direction.
